args.title: Halvorsen Supply Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights autonomous carts and links to a full article plus a free-registration companion piece.
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, though system integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): The biggest cost saving came from a reduction in mis-picks.
